verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a self-hostable agent and RAG platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no first-party sandbox, staging, or dry-run mode for testing agents apart from production data. Tenant isolation, local-only processing and self-hosting are adjacent features, not a sandbox, and the Linux chrome-sandbox install fix is an Electron permission issue unrelated to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
